name: Smartwatch
summary: A watch that is a small touch screen computer. It has a rounded case in aluminium or steel, a glass screen, a digital crown and a soft strap. The Apple Watch of 2015 set the type.

philosophy.core_thesis: A watch is the screen on the wrist. It shows the time, messages and health data. The user changes the face as often as a shirt.
design_principles: Cover the face with a glass touch screen that shows the time as a hands dial or as digits.
Make the case 38 to 49 mm tall and 9 to 12 mm thick, with rounded corners and a back that holds the sensors.
Add a digital crown and one or two buttons that scroll and select.
Let the user change the watch face and the strap, so that one case serves many looks.
Fit a quick-change strap with a slot, a pin or a lug in the case.
Fit sensors on the back for heart rate and blood oxygen, and show the results on the screen.
Make the case in aluminium for the base model and in steel, titanium or ceramic for the upper models.
Charge the watch each day or two on a magnetic puck.
anti_patterns: A mechanical dial with printed hands
A thick plastic case with a small screen
A face that carries no data
A case with fixed lugs that does not take a strap change
A strap that a user cannot replace
An ornate case with gemstones and enamel

silhouette.shape: A rounded rectangle with a glass screen from edge to edge, a digital crown on the right and a soft strap.
silhouette.line: A smooth edge with no bezel, a curved glass and a thin black border round the screen.
silhouette.fit: The back of the case sits on the skin and the strap holds it close for the sensors.
silhouette.proportion: Case thickness to height is about 1 to 4. The screen fills about 85 per cent of the front. The strap is 20 to 24 mm wide.
rules: Make the screen the face, with no markers outside the glass.
Round the corners with a large radius and keep the case edge clean.
Put the crown and the button on one side only.
Make the strap fit in the case with no visible gap.

fabrics.rule: Use aluminium or steel for the case, sapphire or hard glass for the screen, and a soft rubber or woven strap that the user changes.

methods: touch screen with a capacitive layer
sensors on the back of the case
construction.closures: A pin buckle, a magnetic loop or a hook and loop band closes the strap; a quick-release button frees the strap.
construction.details: A glass screen, a digital crown, a back with sensors and a strap that changes in seconds.

surface.pattern: A screen that shows any watch face; the case has no print.
surface.gloss: Anodised aluminium at 20 to 40 GU; polished steel at 85 to 95 GU; the screen at 90 GU.
surface.wear: The glass scratches and the battery loses capacity in two to three years; the rubber strap stains and one replaces it.

palette.strategy: A black screen, a case in a neutral metal tone and a strap in a bright colour that the user chooses.

processes: machining of the case from one block
assembly of sensors and a battery
moulding of the strap in soft rubber
software updates for the watch face
making.scale: Mass production in tens of millions of units a year; a new model each autumn.
making.signs: A glass screen, a digital crown, a rounded case and a strap that clips in.

pieces.form: Rounded aluminium case with a digital crown
Steel case with a polished crown and a brushed side
Curved sapphire glass over a touch screen
Soft rubber sport band with a pin buckle
Woven nylon loop strap with a hook and loop band

positive: glass touch screen edge to edge
black screen with coloured activity rings

emotion.target_response: A sense of contact and health: the viewer sees a small bright screen that knows the wearer.

use_cases: a product shot of a wearable device
an image prompt for a smartwatch on a wrist
avoid_when: the brief wants a mechanical watch
the brief wants a period watch before 2012
the brief wants a craft look

modifiers.how: Use a flat dark face with red digits and a steel case, and remove the touch icons.
Use a bright plastic case with a printed dial and keep the soft one-piece strap.
